name: dima-backend
description: localtld manifest + dev launcher for the Python FastAPI backend (backend.dima.localtld).

scripts.dev: if command -v localtld >/dev/null 2>&1; then localtld run -- sh -c '.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --reload-dir control_plane --port ${PORT:-8000}'; else .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --reload-dir control_plane --port 8000; fi
